content.value: The height of 1000 students are normally distributed with a mean of 174. 5 cm and a standard 1 deviation of 6.9 cm. Assuming that the heights are recorded to the nearest half-centimeter, how many of these students would you expect to have heights (i) less than 160.0 cm? (ii) between 171.5 and 182.0 cm inclusive? (iii) greater than or equal to 188.0 cm?
